title: Lightly Charred Mediterranean Seafood Flatbread
description: A buttery and fluffy flatbread featuring strong white bread flour, topped with a medley of Mediterranean seafood and lightly charred to perfection, perfect as a hangover cure.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the strong white bread flour, active dry yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium high heat.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and brush with unsalted butter.
Top the dough with shrimp, mussels, clams, and feta cheese.
Grill the flatbread for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until it is lightly charred and the seafood is cooked through.
Remove the flatbread from the grill and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
